entry.title: Key differences between API Gateway and Service Mesh
entry.summary:
API Gateways and Service Meshes both deal with service communication and traffic control, but they operate in different parts of the architecture and solve distinct problems. Understanding their differences helps in choosing the right tool or knowing when to use both together. Let’s break it down by key aspects:
API Gateway: It manages north-south traffic, i.e., communication between external clients and internal services by acting as the entry point for all inbound API requests. Service Mesh: They handle east-west traffic, which refers to service-to-service communication inside the application network.
